title: Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros. Styled Volcano
description:
This tileset is completely volcano themed, in the Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros. style.
It also contains a Foreground variant that has slightly more tiles, and the tileset has an animated skull too.

Be sure to give credits to Walmaker, ripped from this sheet!
